title: 第473章 要点盘缠第472章 这年头什么人都有
content_zh:
鸿蒙宇宙之中。
许渊正在四处搜寻着有关混沌之气的线索。
可一方宇宙太大，饶是他画圈修为，竟一时，也只能如同无头苍蝇般四处乱找。
毫无线索。
而且他发现，这方宇宙四处都是破败的星球。
到目前为止，他都没有发现任何生命。
“这是怎么回事？为何这些星球都如此破败？毫无生命痕迹，按理来说，不应该如此......”
“罢了，再看看能不能找到什么线索吧。”
想着，许渊继续飞遁。
同时将庞大的神识释放出去。
又过去几个时辰。
许渊神识忽然查探到了一片存在生命气息的星域。
他当即眼前一亮。
朝着自己所感应的方向而去。
片刻后。
许渊的身形，便已出现在了天冰星域，冰皇城外。
许渊看了一眼紧闭的城门。
直接走了过去。
城墙之上。
当即有一浑身透亮，如同冰雕一般的人形生物大吼道。

天冰族帝都，闲杂人等，速速退去！
许渊却没理会那士兵。
一步踏出。
城门直接碎裂。
“哪里来的贼人，竟敢在我天冰族放肆？”
“真是找死！”
“快，快启动护城大阵，将此人就地轰杀！”
护城大阵瞬间启动。
无数携带滔天威力的冰剑，朝着许渊杀去。
然而，这些冰剑在到达许渊面前三寸之外时，却又瞬间炸裂。
“破！”
许渊一指点头。
护城大阵直接碎裂。
许渊踱步走入城内。
发现此地建筑，竟都是由万年寒冰打造。
极为奇特。
许渊只是多看了几眼，却也并未惊讶。
毕竟宇宙之中无数族群。
各有各的文明。
“竟能破我族护城大阵，阁下究竟是何人，闯我天冰城，有何贵干？”

然而许渊还没走几步。
一身躯庞大的天冰一族强者，却已拦下了他的去路。
content_en:
In Hongmeng Universe.
Xu Yuan is searching everywhere for clues about the energy of chaos.
But the universe is too big, even if he is good at drawing circles, he can only look around like a headless fly for a while.
No clue.
And he discovered that this universe is full of ruined planets.
So far, he has found no life.
"What's going on? Why are these planets so dilapidated? There is no trace of life. Logically speaking, it shouldn't be like this..."
"That's all, let's see if we can find any clues."
Thinking about it, Xu Yuan continued to fly away.
At the same time, the huge spiritual consciousness is released.
A few more hours passed.
Xu Yuan's consciousness suddenly detected a star field where the breath of life existed.
His eyes lit up immediately.
Go in the direction you sense.
After a while.
Xu Yuan's figure had already appeared in the Tianbing Star Territory, outside the Ice Emperor City.
Xu Yuan glanced at the closed city gate.
Walked directly over.
On top of the city wall.
Immediately, a translucent humanoid creature that looked like an ice sculpture roared.
In Tianbing Clan’s imperial capital, there are many people waiting, please retreat quickly!
Xu Yuan ignored the soldier.
Take one step.
The city gate shattered directly.
"Where did the thieves come from and dare to act so recklessly on our Tianbing clan?"
"You're really looking for death!"
"Quick, activate the city defense formation and kill this person on the spot!"
The city defense formation was activated instantly.
Countless ice swords carrying overwhelming power were killing Xu Yuan.
However, when these ice swords reached three inches in front of Xu Yuan, they exploded instantly.
"Broken!"
Xu Yuan pointed and nodded.
The city defense formation immediately shattered.
Xu Yuan walked into the city.
It was discovered that the buildings here were actually made of thousands of years of ice.
Extremely strange.
Xu Yuan just took a few more glances, but was not surprised.
After all, there are countless ethnic groups in the universe.
Each has its own civilization.
"You can actually break through our clan's city defense formation. Who are you? What do you do to break into our Tianbing City?"
However, Xu Yuan hadn't taken a few steps yet.
A huge strong man from the Tianbing clan had blocked his way.
